blocks.text: GAMU, Isabela, Philippines — Soldiers from the Army’s 50th Infantry Battalion engaged about seven suspected New People’s Army (NPA) rebels in a 30-minute firefight in Barangay Dulao, Malibcong, Abra, on Friday evening, Nov. 20. According to police and military reports, the troops were conducting patrol operations when they encountered members of the NPA’s Ilocos-Cordillera Regional Committee operating in Abra. The firefight ended shortly after 6:18 p.m., with no casualties reported on either side.
